{{Quote|For the greater glory of the Empire...DESTROY EVERYTHING!|[[Imperial briefing officer]] to [[TIE pilot]]s|<ref name="TF:DE" />}}
The '''capture of Ali Tarrak''' was the final battle that put an end to the Renegade proliferation of the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]], the capture of the [[Nami]] leader [[Ali Tarrak]] and the conclusion of the [[New Threats]] campaign.

==Prelude==
[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] was the head of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighter]] research and development. His latest creation was the TIE Defender, a fighter with more shields, speed and weaponry then any other starfighter ever made. However, after [[Arms Race|developing]] both the TIE Defender and [[Tractor beam/Legends|Beam]] weapon system installed onto his fighters. [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] believed that Zaarin would serve him well. Unfortunately Zaarin had been planning a [[Zaarin insurrection|Coup d'état]] to become the leader of the Empire himself. His attempted [[Battle of Imperial Center|kidnapping]] had failed, thanks to [[Imperial Ace]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], who had served Zaarin in [[Battle of Mylok IV|gaining]] the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] technology.

After [[Strategic Warfare|destroying]] all the Empire's [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] [[Omar (Deep Space Manufacturing Facilities)|factories]] in the [[Omar system/Legends|Omar system]]. Zaarin focused his attention to his [[Research]] platform as there was still TIE Defender technology to loot and destroy to deprive the Empire of any TIE Defenders. However, loyalist forces, with the help of Maarek Stele [[Capture of Research|thwarted]] his attempts and after the [[Defense of Research|second attempt]] also failed, Zaarin took up himself to destroy the facility himself in his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Glory]]''. However Stele [[Evacuation of Research|held off]] Zaarin long enough for two prototypes to be loaded onto a [[Mharsup|freighter]] and staff, one of which was the [[Unidentified TIE Defender chief scientist|Chief Scientist]] onto a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[G'nabgib]]. The attempt to bring the prototypes to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was not without serious problems. The Chief Scientist was kidnapped by [[Rneekii]] [[Pirate/Legends|Pirates]], while a prototype was [[Ambush on Hashim|stolen]] by [[Nami]] raiders lead by [[Ali Tarrak]].

The Empire had [[Battle of Kiilimaar|rescued]] the scientist from the Rneekii pirates, only to be [[Chemeti's impostor|tricked]] into handing the Chief scientist to Zaarin. Zaarin then gave the scientist to Tarrak who decided to proliferate the TIE Defender technology, in particular to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[Battle of Yrrna|arranged]] a demonstration to the Rebels to showcase their power. Admiral Thrawn had developed a trump card by developing a new fighter called the [[Missile Boat]] and its [[Battle of the Eva-T system|first two]] sorties proved it to be useful. After tracking down Tarrak's factory, Thrawn prepared a full scale assault in his [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Grey Wolf]].

Thrawn had saw in Tarrak a resemblance of himself and convinced Palpatine that she could prove useful, and was ordered to capture Tarrak and bring her to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] so that she be given the opportunity to serve the Emperor.

==The battle==
Thrawns [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] had engaged Tarrak's [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] from [[Pincer Squadron]]. When Stele launched from the ''Grey Wolf'', ''Pincer'' was down to two fighters. Stele engaged [[SubLight Acceleration Motor/Legends|SLAM]] to get past the T-wings and engage the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] that were called [[Gold Devil Squadron]]. Afterwards he tried to destroy TIE Defenders from [[Red Devil Squadron]] and [[Blue Devil Squadron]] but found difficulty as the [[Mine Type C|Mines]] deployed around the [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] [[Tarrak (Deep Space Manufacturing Facility)|''Tarrak'']] intercepted the [[Advanced concussion missile|Warheads]], before they could reach them.

The Defenders soon launched from the containers, despite not having full shields. Red Devil engaged Stele in a dogfight and was defeated while Blue Devil attempted to attack the ''Grey Wolf'' but were intercepted by Stele. After clearing the mines, the ''Grey Wolf'' launched [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]] to destroy the ''Tarrak''. The shields soon fell and Tarrak, abandoned the factory with the Chief scientist in a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Dhoora]]'' Stele launched missiles at the freighter and Tarrak warned them to "stay back or your precious scientist dies!" but Thrawn called her bluff assuring her that such an action would cause her to die as well. [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] were then launched and disabled the freighter then a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Stormtrooper Transport]] [[Epsilon 1]] was launched to board and capture the freighter.

As this was going on a Rebel strike force consisting of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]], then the [[Independence/Legends|Independence]] with two [[Strike-class medium cruiser]]s [[Lonsigar 1]] and [[Lonsigar 2|2]]. The ''Grey Wolf'' launched [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] to help Steele as he destroyed both Strike Cruisers and damaged the Independence enough to prompt it to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]]. The area was secure.

==Aftermath==
The battle was a huge success for the Empire, preventing the potentially uncontrollable proliferation of TIE Defenders to many factions, including, but not limited to the Alliance. Once again, the only TIE Defenders that were a threat to the Empire are the ones under the Command of Zaarin. Thrawn was promoted to Grand Admiral by Palpatine himself and tasked to locate and destroy Zaarin and his [[Zaarin coup forces|loyal command]]. Thrawn resumed his efforts into tracking down the traitor.

Stele himself was presented the [[Medal of Horror]]. He would soon return to duty to help Thrawn hunt down Zaarin.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Well, Mu 1, How does it feel to be a legend?|[[Imperial briefing officer]]|<ref name="TF:DE" />}}
This battle appears in the [[1994]] Computer game ''Star Wars TIE Fighter'' as Battle 10, Combat 6. The battle raises concerns as the cruiser ''Independence'' must be destroyed as part of a "Bonus" objective. This article assumes that the Independence has escaped destruction as the ship is depicted in subsequent media, including but not limited to, ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''.

The TIE Defender group ''Blue Devil'' is seen in game as ''Blue Devl''. This is assumed to be a typo. The ''Independence'' also suffers as it is in the game as ''Independenc'', because of issues.
